SUBCMD_CONFIG_DESCRIPTION: Configure Reddit meme subreddits and frequency
SUBCMD_CONFIG_LIST_TOO_LONG: The current subreddit list exceeds the form limit. Reduce it in the database before editing.
MODAL_CONFIG_ODDS_DESCRIPTION: A number from 0 to 10; 0 disables Reddit fetching
MODAL_CONFIG_SUBREDDITS_DESCRIPTION: Separate with commas or new lines. r/ is optional; leave blank to clear.
MODAL_CONFIG_INVALID_ODDS: Enter a whole number between 0 and 10.
MODAL_CONFIG_INVALID_SUBREDDITS: Invalid subreddit names. Use 2-21 letters, numbers, or underscores (maximum 100).
MODAL_ADD_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_CONTENT: Upload an image. It will be hosted on Imgur.
MODAL_ADD_IMGUR_ERROR: The image could not be uploaded to Imgur.
SUBCMD_GET_DESCRIPTION: Find a meme by ID or name
NO_SUBREDDIT_FOUND: Subreddits is not defined for server {0}!
NO_CONFIG_REDDIT: API for Reddit is not defined!
